definitions.explanation: The splitting of a heavy atomic nucleus, such as uranium, into lighter nuclei, releasing a large amount of energy. The reaction behind nuclear power plants and the atomic bomb. In biology the same word also means the division of a cell nucleus.

examples.japanese: {核分裂|かくぶんれつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧。
⟦ウラン→ウラン：32653_uran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{核分裂|かくぶんれつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{原子力|げんしりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ}→原子力発電所：32094_genshiryokuhatsudensho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{核分裂|かくぶんれつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つくる。
examples.english: A nuclear power plant makes electricity using the heat produced by fission.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {核分裂|かくぶんれつ}⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧: fission reaction
- {核分裂|かくぶんれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause fission
- ⟦{連鎖|れんさ}{反応|はんのう}→連鎖反応：17859_rensahannou⟧: chain reaction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {核融合|かくゆうごう}: nuclear fusion — light nuclei joining, the opposite process
- ⟦{分裂|ぶんれつ}→分裂：11747_bunretsu⟧: split, division — the general word, also of groups and parties
